title: Fix stale AC5 doc comment in epic_26_story_26_20 — still claims hebrewTerms/hebrewDate default to false

evidence.quote: /// AC5: hebrewTerms defaults to false, useHebrewDate defaults to false
'Story 26.20 AC5 — hebrewTerms and useHebrewDate default to true (issue-7a)',

why: The file-level doc comment (written for the original story) still says defaults are false; the group title 184 lines below it, and the tests themselves — which correctly assert isTrue and match the live `defaultValue => true` getters in hebrew_terms_preference.dart / hebrew_date_preference.dart — were updated for fix(issue-7a) but the banner wasn't. A reader who only skims the file header gets the wrong answer.
recommendation: Update lines 10-11 to state defaults are true, referencing fix(issue-7a).
acceptance_criteria: the file header's AC5 line matches the group title and the actual defaultValue getters
